newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan Nov electricity demand rises 5.2 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Japan Nov electricity demand rises 5.2 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Demand for electricity supplied by nine key Japanese power utilities in November rose 5.2 percent from a year earlier to 61.0 billion kilowatt hours (kWh), the Federation of Electric Power Companies said on Friday.

Electricity consumption by large-lot industrial users increased by 3.4 percent to 21.63 billion kWh, the third consecutive month it has risen on a year-on-year basis, a preliminary report by the federation showed.
Growth was spurred by increased demand from steel makers, and makers of electrical and transport machinery, it said.

Electricity consumption by households and offices also grew, with demand for lighting 7.6 percent higher than the same period a year earlier. Consumption in offices for purposes other than lighting grew by 6.0 percent it said.
